name: Rules of Engagement
source:
Your summer on a luxurious tour of Europe takes a wild turn when you learn you're in line for a multi-million dollar inheritance! There's only one catch... you need to get married by the end of the summer!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rules_of_Engagement,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你正在享受一场奢华的欧洲夏日之旅，却突然得知自己有望继承数百万美元的遗产，让这趟旅程发生了意想不到的转折！只是有一个条件…你必须在夏天结束前结婚！

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rules_of_Engagement,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
